content.short: Infrared is a liquid staking protocol for Berachain that simplifies participation in its Proof of Liquidity.
content.description:
Infrared is a core liquid staking protocol built natively for Berachain, designed to optimize participation in the network's unique Proof of Liquidity (PoL) consensus mechanism. By providing liquid versions of key assets, such as iBGT (liquid version of the Berachain Governance Token) and iBERA, the platform enables users to earn rewards and participate in governance while maintaining capital liquidity. This approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for users seeking to maximize their yields within the Berachain ecosystem.

Incubated by the Berachain Foundation, Infrared serves as a vital infrastructure layer that standardizes staking and expands the utility of liquid-staked assets across various DeFi protocols. The platform is designed for high scalability and security, providing a non-custodial experience that ensures user sovereignty. Through its focus on simplifying the Berachain experience and fostering deep liquidity, Infrared is a key driver of growth and participation in the next generation of decentralized finance.
content.meta: Infrared provides liquid staking and Proof of Liquidity optimization for the Berachain ecosystem.
